workItem: Independently assure the SH-02.11A RETRY_SAFE_OPERATION pre-activation Quality boundary on the same implementation generation already verified by Security, while keeping activation HELD.
workItemDE: Die SH-02.11A-Qualitätsgrenze für RETRY_SAFE_OPERATION unabhängig auf derselben bereits von Security verifizierten Pre-Activation-Generation absichern und die Aktivierung weiterhin HELD halten.
priorityReason: RETRY_SAFE_OPERATION must remain HELD until same-generation independent Security and QM assurance are canonical.
projectStage: cross-cutting Quality assurance / no productive PVC transfer
implementationBoundary: Assurance-only. No OPS, Security, runtime, provider, workflow, deployment, retry activation, rollback/restore or Self-Healing implementation mutation.
authorityBoundary: QM evaluates determinism, boundedness, evidence truthfulness and regression safety; it grants no activation, accepted-risk, merge, release, deployment or production authority.
acceptanceCriteria: RETRY_SAFE_OPERATION remains HELD and automatic generic retry remains disabled.
Contract generations remain self-healing-contract/1.2.0 and dependency-resilience/1.0.0.
Only READ_ONLY and explicitly IDEMPOTENT operation classes are retry-safe.
SIDE_EFFECTING and PROTECTED operations fail closed before invocation.
DEPENDENCY_NATIVE and NO_AUTOMATIC_RETRY remain outside generic retry ownership.
Budget remains finite at maxAttempts=3, cooldownMs=500, timeoutMs=10000.
Kill switch self-healing.safe-retry and dependency-operation-readback remain mandatory.
Security #1316 and this QM return are independent evidence domains for the same pre-activation generation.
releaseCondition: Release after Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
releaseReason: Associated independent QM assurance PR #1318 was Human/CODEOWNER-merged as e3f4ce2b5aaaefd62ec562860e0dc3cafa1c38b2; together with Security #1316 it satisfies the same-generation SH-02.11A pre-activation assurance prerequisite.
